scripts.test:ts: bun run build && bun test eval_harness && bun run test:packages
scripts.test:python: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --group test python -m unittest discover -s eval_harness -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:all: bun run typecheck && bun run test:ts && bun run test:python
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/source-scan build && bun run --cwd packages/agent-eval-vitest build && bun run --cwd packages/skill-analyzer build
scripts.test:packages: bun run --cwd packages/source-scan test && bun run --cwd packages/agent-eval-vitest test && bun run --cwd packages/skill-analyzer test
scripts.test:pack: bun run --cwd packages/agent-eval-vitest test:pack && bun run --cwd packages/skill-analyzer test:pack
